dedupe_keys.name: supporting data for design of a direct drive axle mounted traction motor for boosting high speed trains

description: Jonan Morales-Ramiro and colleagues publish disclosed design inputs and numerical results for an axle-mounted permanent-magnet traction motor for high-speed trains. The September 2026 Excel workbook has ten worksheets covering configuration, electromagnetic and thermal calculations, mechanical response, component masses, topology, optimisation settings and benchmarking. It is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The motor fits a constrained wheel-to-axlebox envelope while retaining disc brakes, making the information useful for comparing traction-system assumptions in railway simulations. Results are numerical predictions, not prototype measurements, and preliminary optimisation differs from final design. Detailed CAD, proprietary model definitions and manufacturing information are withheld. Geographic deployment and experimental uncertainty remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this design. The workbook cannot independently reproduce every original simulation and was not downloaded.
